limitations: The association was published previously; novelty is incremental out-of-order prediction.
Mortality provenance overlaps PR #75; this is not independent mortality validation.
Gene-family size neither measures functional repertoires nor identifies immune causation.
Nominal counts are rounding-conditional; all compatible count assignments are reported.
The jackknife interval is approximate for selected, related, unevenly sampled orders.
Phylogenetic reweighting is not covariance adjustment; alternative trees remain untested.
Known-cause deaths in managed populations do not represent all mammalian populations.
Cause-of-death error, ascertainment, gene annotation quality and sample selection remain.
Reproducible arithmetic and CI do not establish source truth or biological validity.
Nonclinical unreviewed research; no medical or veterinary advice.

count_audit.method: Half last decimal unit plus fixed probability tolerance; zero/one exact; nominal ties ROUND_HALF_EVEN; interval endpoints included.

clade_blocks.method: First edge crossing half the median primary-panel tip depth; union groups sharing any order; labels ordered by smallest species identifier.

phylogeny.method: Incoming edge length divided by primary-panel descendants, summed root-to-tip; phylogenetic reweighting only, not covariance adjustment.
phylogeny.source_format: Nexus with TRANSLATE and rooted Newick

reuse.access_method: GitHub API/plain UTF-8 text; no browser download
reuse.individual_records: Restricted Species360 records neither requested nor accessed.
reuse.scope: Original code and derived numerical species aggregates only; no upstream assets mirrored or relicensed.
